items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed. Risk is high for public exposure and security-sensitive releases, and medium for bounded reversible growth. Concrete evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or control results; operations deploy-health, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; all 59 security sitefacts are unknown. Authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release/deployment controls, dependency provenance, complete TLS posture, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. No incident or exploitation is evidenced; missing telemetry is not evidence of safety. Compliance is a technical baseline only, with 36 pass, 17 fail, and 6 unknown. Exact decision: block public exposure and security-sensitive releases, preserve private and parked launch gates, and permit only ordinary reversible growth that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior. Do not claim certification or a clean bill of health.

Continue the existing bounded read-only security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Record dated, redacted evidence and explicit unknowns for authentication/access boundaries, secrets exposure, runtime isolation, release/deployment controls, dependency and supply-chain provenance, TLS, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness. Do not access credentials or private containers, exploit targets, change permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, requeue unchanged work, or conduct external outreach.

For security-sensitive or go-live work, retain status needs_owner until the missing control evidence is attached and reviewed. No implementation is approved for public exposure, launch, alert expansion, dependency adoption, credential or permission changes, or deployment. Ordinary reversible growth remains conditional only when it preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, data boundaries, and rollback behavior.
